title: TelemetryUploadPolicy
description: Upload policy schema controlling client-side telemetry triggers, batching, and target limits.

uploadEnabled.description: Controls whether automatic and trigger-based telemetry upload is enabled.

batchSizeThreshold.description: Number of pending records required to trigger an automatic batch upload.

timeIntervalSeconds.description: Periodic interval in seconds to trigger a batch upload if pending records exist.

maxBatchSize.description: Maximum number of records to include in a single HTTPS upload request body; aligned with the relay hard limit.

clientMaxLocalRecords.description: Target soft capacity for local storage. When exceeded, only synced records are FIFO deleted.

specialTriggers.description: Lifecycle or error conditions that trigger an immediate upload attempt.

policyVersion.description: Monotonically increasing version number for the policy configuration.
